nodes.title: Studio's new templates drawn in the real Desk at 360/412/1280 (r4-content 3ef08301f, expand() at B3, 9 cases + 7 confirm-reveal swaps, n=48 renders). fraction-bars@1 (incl. the shaded '?' second view), wholes@1, lines@1 (cross and 8-angle parallel, revealed) and fraction-line@1 were clean: no text overlap and nothing off the board. number-line-scale@1 tick labels overlap at 0-1000 step 100 and at 0-100000 step 20000: the player draws them at 19.2 units in Geist Mono, 11.5 units per digit, while the template allows intervals of 31.6 and 63.2 units. textBox estimates about 10.4 units per digit, and the numwork layout has no row-label lint.

## `m-r7-app-studio-templates-render-2026-11-07`
Method: Studio's own expand() boards injected into the dev Desk's work tray (window.__deskScript), shot after the full board duration, with drawn SVG text boxes tested pairwise and against the board. Details and the suggested rule are in docs/design/round7/app/BOARDS-RENDER.md.
